abstract: As retinoic acid (RA) and dibutyryl cAMP (cAMP) treatment induces differentiation of mouse teratocarcinoma F9 cells into parietal endoderm cells in vitro, we initiated studies on the molecular mechanisms underlying early mammalian cell differentiation in this system. We constructed cDNA libraries on the poly(A)+RNAs extracted from the undifferentiated F9 cells, and screened for cDNA sequences expressed abundantly in F9 cells, but not in terminally differentiated mouse parietal endoderm PYS-2 cells. Six different cDNA clones were isolated and characterized. The levels of RNAs hybridizable to these clones were at most 5 to 24% in the PYS-2 cells when compared with those in the undifferentiated F9 cells. The six clones were classified into two groups on the basis of their responses to the RA and cAMP treatment. In F9 cells, the levels of RNAs hybridizable to the first group, which contained four clones, were decreased within 72 h after the addition of RA and cAMP, while those of the second group, which contained the remaining two clones, did not decrease significantly. One of the first group clones, named pF9-1, corresponded to the mouse "early transposon-like elements" and another, named pF9-4, hybridized to multi-size RNAs extracted from the undifferentiated F9 cells. The mouse genomic DNA sequences hybridizable to pF9-4 were repeated approximately 5,000 times, and comprise a new gene family, the expression of which is developmentally regulated in mouse F9 cells.
abstract_ja: F9マウス奇形癌細胞は、レチノイン酸(RA)およびジブチリルcAMP(cAMP)処理により、試験管内で壁側内胚葉細胞に分化する。われわれは、この系を用いて初期哺乳類細胞分化の分子機構の研究を開始した。未分化F9細胞由来のポリA(+)RNAからcDNAライブラリーを作製し、終末分化したマウス壁側内胚葉PYS-2細胞では発現せず、F9細胞で豊富に発現するcDNA配列をスクリーニングした。6種類のcDNAクローンを単離し、特性を解析した。これらのクローンに対応するRNAのレベルは、PYS-2細胞では未分化F9細胞の5～24%にすぎなかった。6クローンは、RAおよびcAMP処理への応答により2群に分類された。F9細胞では、4クローンを含む第1群のRNA量は、RAおよびcAMP添加後72時間以内に減少した。一方、残り2クローンを含む第2群は有意な減少を示さなかった。第1群のクローンのうちpF9-1はマウスの「初期トランスポゾン様因子」に対応し、pF9-4は未分化F9細胞由来の複数サイズのRNAとハイブリダイズした。pF9-4にハイブリダイズするマウスゲノムDNA配列は約5,000回反復しており、発現が発生段階特異的に制御される新規遺伝子ファミリーを構成する。
